## Cost analysis

`cost = memory + params`; the scorer excludes **both** `input` and `output` from memory (`neurogolf_utils.calculate_memory` line 234 — input is free, not just output). memory = **sum** of counted intermediates in dtype-**bytes**; params = sum of initializer **elements** (a shared initializer counts **once**).

`tetra_code` uses a 1x1 Conv with negative END pads `[0,0,-27,-27]` to crop the active `3x3` and linearly encode the four legal colors into R3:
`0=[1,1,1]`, `1=[1,-1,-1]`, `2=[-1,1,-1]`, `3=[-1,-1,1]`. The final Einsum applies the same vectors as class decoders, so the correct class has dot product `+3`; the other three legal classes are `-1`; unused channels 4..9 are exactly `0`. NeuroGolf decodes `>0`, so this is byte-equal after thresholding while carrying only `[1,3,3,3]` F32 = **108 B**. Params: Conv weights `[3,10,1,1]` = 30 + decode `[10,3]` = 30 + shared mirror map `[30,3]` = 90 => **150**; total **258**.

The `einsum` rung does crop→mirror-tile→pad in **one** op: `Slice(input,[0:3,0:3])` → `[1,10,3,3]` F32 = **360 B** (the only counted tensor) → `Einsum('bchw,hH,wW->bcHW', crop, M, M)` → free `output`. `M=[3,30]` selection (`M[h,H]=1` iff out-row H samples in-row h; cols 0–5→rows `[0,1,2,2,1,0]`, cols 6–29 zero=pad), **shared** by both axes (symmetric mirror) → counted **once** = 90. + Slice consts 6 = 96 params.

vs `padlast` (519): padlast materializes every mirror step (Conv/Cast/2×Slice/2×Concat/Equal) as counted tensors = 360 one-hot + **126 B build chain** + 33 params. The einsum collapses that 126 B build chain into the **scorer-invisible in-kernel pairwise temp** `[1,10,30,3]` (#89; `calculate_memory` line 262 skips unnamed tensors), trading it for +63 params (90 map vs 33) → **net −63**.

## Old floor proof (456, stale)

REGIME 1 (crop-then-process): any op touching the free input emits a counted intermediate; the smallest one carrying the full 3×3×10 one-hot is `[1,10,3,3]`, and Slice/Pad/Conv/Cast **preserve the F32 input dtype** → ≥ 90·4 = **360 B**. (A u8/bool crop needs an extra Cast: crop-F32 360 + cast-u8 90 = 450, or full-cast 9000 + crop — both worse. ORT CPU Einsum is **float/double/int32/int64-only** (`einsum.md` / L2 source-read) → no sub-4-byte einsum input.) The einsum-final route has **exactly** this one counted tensor + shared map 90 + slice 6 = **456**.
REGIME 2 (never crop, params-only): feed the free full input to a free-output final op carrying only initializers → Einsum full-input map `[30,30]`=900; GridSample grid `[1,30,30,2]`=1800. Both > 456.

Why task142 wins where task083 (681) doesn't: task083's einsum = crop `[1,10,3,4]`=480 + **two** distinct maps `[3,30]+[4,30]`=210 → 690 > 681 (KILL). task142's mirror is **symmetric** (H-map == W-map) so **one** `[3,30]` map serves both axes, and the crop is `[1,10,3,3]`=360 (not 480) → 456 < 519.

## Don't-do log

- **padlast / pad-last reorder** (Equal one-hot on 6×6 first → Pad): 519. Superseded by einsum-final (456); the mirror build chain (126 B counted) is dead weight — einsum hides it in the in-kernel temp.
- **Equal-last ordering** (pad 1-ch index to `[1,1,30,30]`=900 B then Equal): 1,059. KILL.
- **GridSample small-grid `[1,6,6,2]` → Pad** (old LIVE 1,520): `[1,10,6,6]` **F32** = 1,440 B before Pad. KILL.
- **int8/uint8 einsum input** to shrink the 360 B crop: ORT CPU Einsum has no int8/uint8 kernel (float/double/int32/int64 only) — int32 is still 4 B (no gain), and a u8 crop costs an extra Cast (≥450). 360 B F32 crop is firm.
- **F16 einsum** (shrink crop to 180 B): multi-operand F16 einsum is NOT byte-equal (task191, 0.042 drift). Don't.
- **fp16 conversion** (SPREAD scan + 2026-05-20 SG_ALL): +36000 B regression. Don't.
- **10-channel-throughout mirror** (no index collapse): ~10× heavier intermediates. KILL.
- **U8/QLinearConv crop route** (#96/#137 prompt route): QLinearConv cannot consume the F32 graph input without a full-frame quantize/cast, and leaving the einsum family re-materializes at least the `[1,10,6,6]` one-hot = 360 B before Pad. The signed 3-feature Conv crop keeps the final free-output Einsum and wins.
- **1-channel scalar color-index crop**: cheaper carrier (9-36 B) but nonlinear one-hot reconstruction needs OneHot/Equal materialization or a polynomial feature basis. The one-hot tail alone exceeds the 282 target unless the decode remains inside the free-output final op.
